Before raising a bug, please read the [documentation](https://mindrustuk.github.io/Heatmiser-for-home-assistant/).

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Diagnostics** 
Always include [diagnostics](https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/configuration/troubleshooting/#download-diagnostics) output, ideally as an attached file.

**Error logs** 
If there are any errors in the home assistant logs, please include them here. We might need debug logs at a later stage, but the error trace and diagnostics are usually sufficient.

**To Reproduce**
If you can reliably reproduce the issue, add the steps here. 

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
